one_liner: Indian markets decline amid global cues and sector-specific pressures.

drivers.title: Global Cues
drivers.detail: US and European markets ended higher, but Asia was mixed.

drivers.title: IT Sector Surge
drivers.detail: Nifty IT rose 2.88% with major IT stocks gaining.

drivers.title: Broader Market Pressure
drivers.detail: Midcap and smallcap indices fell significantly.

drivers.title: Volatility Spike
drivers.detail: India VIX surged, indicating increased market volatility.

flows_line: FIIs and DIIs were net buyers with inflows of Rs 1,022.32 Cr and Rs 1,614.32 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for USD unemployment claims data at 22:00 IST tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Global cues can drive local market sentiment.
Sector-specific performance can offset broader market trends.
Volatility indices are key indicators of market sentiment.
Institutional flows provide insights into market direction.
